goal: Prevent the wallet encryption RPC from falsely reporting failure when the wallet is already encrypted
Avoid misleading users when re-unlocking the newly encrypted wallet fails
agreement: Disputed with an open safety objection
Blocking objection: unlock failure indicates severe corruption and continuing risks fund loss (achow101)
Author acknowledged logging may be wrong but has not pushed a revised fix

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because it fixes a misleading RPC error in an extreme edge case
Triggering an unlock failure right after encryption requires memory corruption or test mutation
